title: Aura on every standing text
notes: R5039000: Aura: added to the standing line of Core #38, #64, #73, #75, #84, M #11, #92, S #148, #157, T-shield-layer, S+ #30, #42, #62, #63; removed from the own-text line of M #65, S #111, T-drone-interceptor, T-drone-corvette, S+ #87, #163. English and Chinese, wording only.

player.title: Aura on every standing text
text: Every line that keeps working while its card is on the field and changes other cards, a player or a hero now starts with "Aura:".
Fourteen cards gain it, among them Anti-oneshot Armor, Going Long, Unan, The Gauntlet and Force Projector.
Keymaster Keenus, Shockwave447, Frontier Flora, Accelerationist and the Drones lose it: text about the card itself reads like a keyword.
No card plays differently: only the words changed, in English and Chinese.
